name: A rollout plan becomes a live flowchart inside the chat
object: interactive tools in Claude: connected apps like Figma, Amplitude, Asana and Slack rendering as live, clickable widgets directly inside a conversation instead of plain text replies
audience: product managers and operators coordinating a cross-tool rollout, design, data, tasks and comms, who live in chat
message: This video tells operators that Claude's connected tools stop being text summaries and become things you can click, edit and ship without leaving the chat.

moments.what: a user asks Claude to help map out a rollout plan for a meeting later that day
moments.copy: I'm meeting with Conor today about the dashboard redesign, can you help me map out the rollout plan?

moments.what: Claude pulls up Figma and renders an interactive rollout flowchart with decision gates, deploy 25%, monitor, deploy 50%, announce, directly inside the thread
moments.copy: Here's your rollout flow with decision gates at each stage.

moments.what: pulls Amplitude engagement data into a live, clickable line chart comparing the new design against control, then creates an Asana checklist for the rollout tasks
moments.copy: Here's the engagement trend. The staging group is up about 40% compared to control.

moments.what: drafts and sends a Slack message to Conor summarizing the rollout plan and the engagement lift, with a message-sent confirmation, closing on the Claude wordmark
moments.copy: Dashboard redesign is ready to ship. Engagement in the staging group is up ~40% vs control. Rollout plan for Thursday: 25% -> monitor 2hrs -> 50% -> monitor 2hrs -> 100%.

cta: no spoken call to action; the film ends on the sent Slack confirmation and the Claude logo, the finished send itself standing in as proof
why: Chaining four different connected tools into one scroll, each one interactive rather than a static summary, demonstrates that Claude can actually operate across a stack instead of just describing it.
